text:
Hi Leyla!

I believe the answer to your question is that the embassy of IL to Sweden does not need to be involved, but I am certainly no expert. I believe you apply for an ETA-IL through the website: https://israel-entry.piba.gov.il/

It does not matter if Sweden is visa exempt for tourist visas (which are named as B2, thank you Anja Hohenester-Zimmern!!!). You’re going to receive this special, different B1 as part of your journey to an A5 spousal visa, and that’s a completely separate journey according to the misrad hapnim.

With love and best wishes: chances are, everything won’t go well in your husband’s appointment in September. My partner is continuously surprised to find out that government offices in Israel don’t work for me like they work for him. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
